title: REGULATIONS APPLICABLE TO ALL AREAS
previewText: The provisions of Sections 96-51 (Mandatory Tree Planting Provisions) and 96-52 (Bulk Modifications for Public Parking Garages) shall apply to all areas within the Special District.
